_comment: Prepared entry for the dshworks/awesome-dsh-plugins registry. Append this object to the `plugins` array in data/plugins.json, set `updated` to the submission date, then run `node scripts/validate.mjs` and `node scripts/render.mjs` and commit both files. Validated against the registry schema on 2026-08-16 (validate: ok, 2759 plugins). `status` may only stay `verified` once the npm package is published, because the registry's spam gate defines the install path for a plugin as a published package a profile can depend on. Until then the honest value is `unverified` and the `npm` field should be dropped.
name: dsh-airlock
description: Labels context by where it came from and denies capabilities over those labels, so a denied call cannot be reformulated into an allowed one.
